name: Salvation
source:
Finally, my salvation has come.

Evan Wilhelm was dead. I killed him.

Evan Wilhelm lost his final duel against Clarissa Edelrose. The day she could defeat him was a day that he had been waiting for. To be freed, that was his salvation. Clarissa thought that by killing Evan and getting her revenge, she too, would be at peace, but she was wrong.

[from [url=https://altila.itch.io/salvation]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
终于，我的救赎来了。

埃文·威廉死了。我杀了他。

埃文·威廉 (Evan Wilhelm) 在与克拉丽莎·埃德尔罗斯 (Clarissa Edelrose) 的最后一场决斗中失败。她能够打败他的那一天，是他一直在等待的一天。获得自由，这就是他的救赎。克拉丽莎以为杀了埃文并报仇，她也会得到平静，但她错了。

[来自[url=https://altila.itch.io/salvation]itch.io[/url]]
